thread:
devin_eng: kicking off rolling deploy for service=llm-router v5 -> v6. feature flag llm_route_v6 will be ramped to 10% across canary cohort in prod-eu at 22:00 UTC. tagging release notes: reduce-kv-cache-alloc

deploy-bot: Deploy job started: deploy/llm-router/v6 to canary slice (ids: canary-eu). CI: ✅, smoke: ✅. Will auto-ramp to 25% after 30m if health OK. See: https://ci.redwood/1234

maria_pm: Copy — we should pin sessions=sticky for canary to avoid cross-cohort skew. Also FYI QA flagged a small mem increase in perf tests but said it was within tolerance.

anita_release: noted. added to release notes: "observed +4% mem in perf harness; watch canary traces"

sre_oncall: Heads up — our memory alert baseline for prod-eu is tight tonight (maintenance window). I'll be watching. If we see 5% p95 mem bump, we should hold and roll back.

ops_robin: Tagged the change window in calendar: 22:00-23:30 UTC. Oncall coverage confirmed.

deploy-bot: At 22:12 UTC: ramp to 10% complete. Health: latency OK, error rate 0.01%. Telemetry note: incremental rise in memory allocation over first 5 mins (avg +1.8%).

devin_eng: seeing the same in traces — p95 mem +3% and some longer GC pauses in a small subset of hosts. Not yet at abort threshold but worth flagging.

sre_oncall: I'm hitting host telemetry now — 3 hosts show sustained heap growth (canary-eu-2/4/7). Setting temporary holdpoint.

sre_oncall: HOLD -- manual hold engaged on deploy bot. Ramping paused at 10%. Requesting decision: continue soak or rollback to v5?

maria_pm: let's give it a short soak (15m) but prepare rollback steps. If more hosts drift or p95 mem >= +5% -> rollback.

devin_eng: agree with soak. I'll collect heapdumps from the 3 hosts and run a quick diff. Preparing a pinned rollout plan for rapid rollback.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged hold. Current state saved. To rollback now use: "/deploy rollback llm-router --to-version v5 --scope canary-eu --force"

ops_robin: adding rapid rollback SOP to thread: keep traffic pin config handy and unpin routing before full rollback if any session stickiness impacts.

anita_release: updating release notes with "paused ramp due to memory signal in canary; investigating, rollback on threshold" and pinging customers on scheduled maintenance group.

devin_eng: quick heap-diff showed a new buffer growth path in kv-cache module only for larger seq inputs. I can push a microhotfix, but it's risky during window. Recommend rollback if we cross threshold.

sre_oncall: 22:22 UTC telemetry: p95 mem now +4.9% on canary-eu-2. If any host hits +5% persistently for 2 min -> rollback. Preparing rollback command: /deploy rollback llm-router --to-version v5 --scope canary-eu

maria_pm: ack. 2-min rule seems sensible. also please capture core dumps before any instance restart.

deploy-bot: Rollback dry-run scheduled. If executed, will drain canary-eu nodes, unpin versions, and revert flag llm_route_v6->0 for canary cohort.

sre_oncall: 22:25 UTC — canary-eu-7 spiking p95 mem +6.1% and GC pause >200ms. Executing rollback now.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback: /deploy rollback llm-router --to-version v5 --scope canary-eu --force

ops_robin: rolling back traffic slice, unpinning canary session sticky. Command: /flag set llm_route_v6 0 --cohort=canary-eu --reason="mem regression"

devin_eng: observed quick recovery on the 3 hosts once traffic shifted. Monitoring traces for residual errors.

anita_release: updated release notes: "v6 rollout paused/rolled back on canary due to memory regression; investigation ongoing; next steps: revert kv-cache change or ship micropatch after validation"

maria_pm: thanks all. Action items: (1) dev to triage kv-cache growth and propose micropatch, (2) run extended perf tests with larger seq inputs, (3) schedule a muted reattempt with extra observability after fix.

sre_oncall: Postmortem bake: I'll open an incident ticket with telemetry graphs. For now, lowering alert thresholds on canary so next ramp auto-holds earlier.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 22:30 UTC. Canary traffic restored to v5. No user-facing errors detected during rollback.

devin_eng: pulling diffs and heapdumps to a private slice for root-cause. Will update the incident ticket with findings.

maria_pm: closing loop: keep this thread for notes; we'll re-run a slow ramp once micropatch validated. :thumbsup:
